steps.title: Assembly path overview
steps.coach_encourage: Honest complexity beats a stuck bumper clip at midnight.
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Sealed / integrated LED (and many projector) lamps often replace as a unit. Complexity ranges from a few fasteners to bumper removal. If you must support the car or remove under-trays heavily, prefer a qualified tech.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Grade the job
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Easy: lamp accessible with grille/cover clips. Moderate: inner fender liner. Hard: bumper cover off, headlamp aim sensors, adaptive modules. Hard → shop. Adaptive/matrix lamps may need specialized diagnosis and aim after install.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Shop is the smart call
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Bring photos of the housing, trim, and any bulb-out messages. Ask the shop about aim after replacement. This app is education — not a repair authorization.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Prep & disconnect
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Battery negative disconnect if the manual calls for it on your model. Bag fasteners. Photograph connector orientations. Never pry on orange HV cables on hybrids/EVs.
steps.safety_warning: Electrical connectors and sharp body edges. Support panels so they do not crack.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Swap the lamp
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Support the assembly. Transfer any brackets only as designed. Seat seals; do not overtighten plastic tabs. Do not invent OEM part numbers — use the packing label / dealer lookup with VIN at the counter.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Basic wall aim (not lab calibration)
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: On level ground, mark a wall reference roughly matching factory height. Adjust only if your housing has DIY aim screws. Professional photometry / adaptive calibration is shop work — we do not claim DIY lab aim.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
